verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents automation through its CLI (scripted install, configuration, connection and removal) and a REST API, so the automation-depth axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows the product versioning, reviewing, or rolling back those automations. Any version control of batch scripts would be a user-side workaround, not a product capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
